1.asv: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,

2.web: “Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind?
2.asv: Should a wise man make answer with vain knowledge, And fill himself with the east wind?

3.web: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, or with speeches with which he can do no good?
3.asv: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, Or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?

4.web: Yes, you do away with fear, and hinder devotion before God.
4.asv: Yea, thou doest away with fear, And hinderest devotion before God.

5.web: For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.
5.asv: For thine iniquity teacheth thy mouth, And thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.

6.web: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I. Yes, your own lips testify against you.
6.asv: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I; Yea, thine own lips testify against thee.

7.web: “Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought out before the hills?
7.asv: Art thou the first man that was born? Or wast thou brought forth before the hills?

8.web: Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?
8.asv: Hast thou heard the secret counsel of God? And dost thou limit wisdom to thyself?

9.web: What do you know, that we don’t know? What do you understand, which is not in us?
9.asv: What knowest thou, that we know not? What understandest thou, which is not in us?

10.web: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much elder than your father.
10.asv: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, Much elder than thy father.

11.web: Are the consolations of God too small for you, even the word that is gentle toward you?
11.asv: Are the consolations of God too small for thee, Even the word that is gentle toward thee?

12.web: Why does your heart carry you away? Why do your eyes flash,
12.asv: Why doth thy heart carry thee away? And why do thine eyes flash,

13.web: That you turn your spirit against God, and let such words go out of your mouth?
13.asv: That against God thou turnest thy spirit, And lettest words go out of thy mouth?

14.web: What is man, that he should be clean? What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
14.asv: What is man, that he should be clean? And he that is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

15.web: Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones. Yes, the heavens are not clean in his sight;
15.asv: Behold, he putteth no trust in his holy ones; Yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight:

16.web: how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks iniquity like water!
16.asv: How much less one that is abominable and corrupt, A man that drinketh iniquity like water!

17.web: “I will show you, listen to me; that which I have seen I will declare:
17.asv: I will show thee, hear thou me; And that which I have seen I will declare

18.web: (Which wise men have told by their fathers, and have not hidden it;
18.asv: (Which wise men have told From their fathers, and have not hid it;

19.web: to whom alone the land was given, and no stranger passed among them):
19.asv: Unto whom alone the land was given, And no stranger passed among them):

20.web: the wicked man writhes in pain all his days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.
20.asv: The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days, Even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.

21.web: A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer shall come on him.
21.asv: A sound of terrors is in his ears; In prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.

22.web: He doesn’t believe that he shall return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword.
22.asv: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, And he is waited for of the sword.

23.web: He wanders abroad for bread, saying, ‘Where is it?’ He knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.
23.asv: He wandereth abroad for bread, saying, Where is it? He knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

24.web: Distress and anguish make him afraid. They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.
24.asv: Distress and anguish make him afraid; They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.

25.web: Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty;
25.asv: Because he hath stretched out his hand against God, And behaveth himself proudly against the Almighty;

26.web: he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers;
26.asv: He runneth upon him with astiffneck, With the thick bosses of his bucklers;

27.web: because he has covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat on his thighs.
27.asv: Because he hath covered his face with his fatness, And gathered fat upon his loins;

28.web: He has lived in desolate cities, in houses which no one inhabited, which were ready to become heaps.
28.asv: And he hath dwelt in desolate cities, In houses which no man inhabited, Which were ready to become heaps;

29.web: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, neither shall their possessions be extended on the earth.
29.asv: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, Neither shall their possessions be extended on the earth.

30.web: He shall not depart out of darkness. The flame shall dry up his branches. By the breath of God’s mouth shall he go away.
30.asv: He shall not depart out of darkness; The flame shall dry up his branches, And by the breath ofGod’smouth shall he go away.

31.web: Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself; for emptiness shall be his reward.
31.asv: Let him not trust in vanity, deceiving himself; For vanity shall be his recompense.

32.web: It shall be accomplished before his time. His branch shall not be green.
32.asv: It shall be accomplished before his time, And his branch shall not be green.

33.web: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast off his flower as the olive tree.
33.asv: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, And shall cast off his flower as the olive-tree.

34.web: For the company of the godless shall be barren, and fire shall consume the tents of bribery.
34.asv: For the company of the godless shall be barren, And fire shall consume the tents of bribery.

35.web: They conceive mischief, and produce iniquity. Their heart prepares deceit.”
35.asv: They conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity, And their heart prepareth deceit.
